settings.intro_text: Ibrahim Al Qurashi, also known as IBRAQ, is a heritage Gulf perfume house rooted in the art of oud, amber, and rich Arabian blends. The Fragrance Secrets brings together authentic Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes, from the bold, oud-driven Blue Oud to the Purple Heart Diamond and collections spanning musk, tobacco, and precious gemstone themes. Meticulously crafted with high-quality ingredients and built for serious longevity, these are fragrances for those who want depth, character, and true Arabian luxury. If you love heritage oud perfumery with a modern polish, Ibrahim Al Qurashi is a house to explore.

settings.title: A Gulf Heritage House
settings.body: Ibrahim Al Qurashi, known as IBRAQ, is one of the well-established perfume names of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, built on a deep heritage in oud, amber, and traditional Arabian perfumery.

settings.title: The Iconic Blue Oud
settings.body: Ibrahim Al Qurashi is known for standout scents like Blue Oud, a bold composition of oud and blue lily over patchouli, leather, amber, and tobacco, dark, complex, and unmistakably luxurious.

settings.title: Rich Collections
settings.body: From Diamonds and Gemstones to Musk and Tobacco, Ibrahim Al Qurashi offers rich, distinctive collections built around oud, amber, florals, and exotic spices, each crafted for a memorable signature.

settings.title: Built to Last
settings.body: Made with high-quality ingredients, Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes are known for exceptional longevity and projection that linger through the day, performing especially well in warm climates like the UAE.

settings.question: Is Ibrahim Al Qurashi a good perfume brand?
settings.answer: Yes. Ibrahim Al Qurashi, or IBRAQ, is a respected Gulf heritage house known for rich oud and amber fragrances, high-quality ingredients, and exceptional longevity, popular with lovers of Arabian perfumery.

settings.question: What is Ibrahim Al Qurashi known for?
settings.answer: Ibrahim Al Qurashi is known for deep, oud-driven Arabian perfumery, with standout scents like Blue Oud and Purple Heart Diamond and collections spanning musk, tobacco, diamonds, and gemstone themes.

settings.question: What does Ibrahim Al Qurashi Blue Oud smell like?
settings.answer: Blue Oud opens with bold oud and blue lily, moving into patchouli and leather, with a base of amber and tobacco. It is dark, complex, and known for powerful longevity.

settings.question: Do Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes last long?
settings.answer: Yes. Made with high-quality ingredients, Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes are known for strong projection and exceptional longevity, performing especially well in warm climates like the UAE.

settings.answer: Yes. Every Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfume at The Fragrance Secrets is 100% authentic and sourced through trusted suppliers, sealed and quality-checked, so you can shop with complete confidence.

settings.question: Do you ship Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. The Fragrance Secrets delivers Ibrahim Al Qurashi perfumes across the UAE and also ships to customers in the USA and Canada. Shipping options and delivery estimates are available during checkout.
